news.headline: Global Market: HSBC third-quarter profit jumps 32% to $9.6 billion
news.summary: HSBC has announced a remarkable 32% rise in pretax profits for the third quarter, totaling $9.6 billion. This surge is attributed to increased interest rates and a decrease in anticipated credit losses, significantly boosting profitability. However, despite these promising results and a share buyback initiative, the bank's shares saw a decline of over 3%. The interim dividend remains steady at $0.

news.headline: Global Market: JGB yields climb as investors await BOJ, Fed policy decisions
news.summary: Japanese government bond prices declined as a rally in AI-related equities reduced demand for safe-haven assets. The benchmark 10-year JGB yield rose to 2.795%, while shorter- and longer-term yields mostly increased. Investors are awaiting policy signals from the US Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan, particularly guidance on the timing of Japan’s next interest-rate hike.

news.headline: Q2 earnings done for HDFC Bank, ICICI, other private lenders. What's next?
news.summary: Private banks delivered mixed Q2 FY27 earnings, prompting analysts to identify lenders with attractive valuations and flag those investors may want to avoid. HDFC Bank reported a 5% YoY rise in net profit to Rs 19,510 crore, largely in line with expectations, but its shares have fallen 6% since the results.

news.headline: Jio’s big-bang listing may give it stock market’s No.2 crown after Reliance Industries
news.summary: Jio Platforms could overtake Bharti Airtel to become India’s second-largest listed company after its October 28 debut, with a 22% grey market premium implying a market capitalisation of Rs 12.5 lakh crore. Its Rs 30,213-crore IPO drew 22.2 times subscription, while brokerages highlighted growth opportunities in broadband, enterprise technology and AI.

news.headline: Coca-Cola raises profit forecast as premium drinks, sodas hold strong
news.summary: Coca-Cola has lifted its annual profit forecast, driven by robust demand for a range of beverages, particularly zero-sugar options. The company now anticipates earnings per share growth of at least 9% by 2026. Their third-quarter revenue soared to $13.38 billion, exceeding analysts' expectations, while Coca-Cola's strong showing stands in sharp contrast to PepsiCo's recent downgrades and cost-cutting plans. Following these promising results, Coca-Cola shares rose nearly 1% in premarket trading.

news.headline: A banking giant, a battered stock: Can HDFC Bank’s new chief turn the tide?
Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks slip as technology shares extend losses
news.summary: China and Hong Kong stocks edged lower as weakness in technology and AI-related shares outweighed faster industrial-profit growth and fresh liquidity support from China’s central bank.

news.headline: TCS, Infosys, other IT stocks drop up to 3% as Anthropic IPO sparks rally in global AI stocks
news.summary: Indian IT stocks fell amid reports that Anthropic, the maker of Claude, is preparing for an IPO that could value it at around $1.5 trillion. While the listing would open up investment opportunities in a leading AI developer, rising infrastructure costs, mounting losses and concerns over growth sustainability remain key risks.

news.headline: HAL, BEL, Paras Defence, other stocks rise up to 4% after DAC clears  proposals worth Rs 2.12 lakh crore
news.summary: India’s Defence Acquisition Council approved defence procurement proposals worth Rs 2.12 lakh crore, with 82% expected from domestic industry. The clearances cover helicopters, drones, air-defence systems, artillery and naval platforms, supporting military modernisation. Defence stocks may gain investor attention, while indigenous manufacturing, rising capital expenditure and policy support strengthen long-term sector growth prospects.

news.headline: RIL to announce Q2 results on October 30, board to also consider fundraising
news.summary: Reliance Industries will announce its September-quarter results on October 30, alongside considering fundraising through non-convertible debentures. Investors will track performance across O2C, telecom, retail and energy businesses amid share price weakness and market uncertainty.

news.headline: US stocks today: S&P 500, Nasdaq advance as oil eases ahead of Fed decision
news.summary: US stocks are experiencing an uptick with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq gaining due to easing oil prices. The Federal Reserve is expected to maintain rates steady in its upcoming decision after last month's hike. Investors are keenly anticipating earnings results from major technology firms, which will provide insights into AI investments. Boeing and Xylem faced losses, while Royal Caribbean and General Motors reported positive forecasts.

news.headline: Larsen & Toubro Q2 Results: Profit surges 33% YoY to Rs 5,202 crore, revenue grows 16%
news.summary: L&T Q2 Results: Larsen & Toubro announced significant financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 33% increase in consolidated profit after tax compared to the previous year. Consolidated revenue also grew by 16%, driven by strong performance across various sectors. Additionally, L&T achieved its highest quarterly order inflow and saw substantial international participation in its orders.

news.headline: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares crash 10% after Q2 net profit tumbles 54%; firm declares Rs 5/share dividend
news.summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares plunged 10% after the state-owned company reported a 54% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 344 crore. Revenue from operations fell 16.5% to Rs 2,446 crore, while margins contracted sharply. The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share.

news.headline: Global Market: European shares fall as HSBC earnings drag banking stocks
news.summary: European shares fell as HSBC's disappointing revenue weighed on banking stocks, while political unrest in France dampened investor sentiment. The STOXX 600 slipped, with gains in healthcare stocks following Novartis' upgraded earnings outlook offering some support.

news.headline: Rupee boxed in range; traders focus on oil, outflows and RBI's defence
news.summary: The Indian rupee had a day of modest variability against the dollar on Tuesday, finishing the day almost unchanged.
